items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 31:1
items.html: For the Mochin of Gadlut of Aba ve Ima also come from the second division of Nekudim, from the aspect of PBP, which were there completed entirely in each of their aspects of GAR, before they received the MAN of Vav and a dot from the Yesod of AK. And it is known that the breaking occurred only in the Mochin that come from the MAN of the Yesod of AK, and although the Mochin of the second division were also nullified, this was only because they became joined together with the Mochin of the third division that come from Vav and a dot. Hence, now that they have already been clarified and separated from the Mochin of the third division, there is no longer any flaw in them, and the Mochin remain fixed. Moreover, the whole matter of the lack of permanence in the Mochin is due to the flaw that the lower ones raise, and the deeds of the lower ones do not reach the aspect of the Mochin of Aba ve Ima that come from the second division, since the lower ones have no part in them, for they come from the Mochin of the third division. Hence they cannot, through their deeds, cause the departure of the Mochin except in ZON, whose Gadlut likewise comes from the third division. (Inner Light, page 620, Sub Header, “In AVI.” And page 658, Sub Header, “And With This You Will Understand”)
